[[Minotaur (Crystal Desert)|Minotaurs]] are the brown, stone-backed, desert form of the [[minotaur]] species.

These monsters are commonly found in groups of 3-4. They are quite sturdy and have a above-average movement speed. Be careful with them because they often have wandering patrol paths.
